g.text: Per-connector selection works via deniedMcpServers (verified). Selecting
any connector switches from --strict-mcp-config to name-based blocking of
computer use via cmux's bundled helper
6 hook group(s) on 6 events (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, …)
~1,200 tokens · 105 tools upfront (Tool Search) · up to ~16,900 if every schema gets loaded
↑↓ move through all boxes · Space toggle · Enter launch · Ctrl+S save profile · Ctrl+R refresh connectors · Ctrl+T theme · Esc
